subject: Charge on the statement nobody recognises
body: There is a charge of 84 euro on the 14th. Nobody here set it up and it is not on last month's statement. What is it?

subject: Standing payment did not go out
body: The insurance payment was due on the 1st and never left the account. Nothing on screen says why.

subject: Charged interest at a rate we were not quoted
body: The credit line statement shows a rate above the one we agreed. Should we just cancel the credit line to stop it?

subject: Locked out and the code is not arriving
body: One of the team cannot get in. The text message with the code never comes and there is no other way through on the screen.

subject: How long do we have to reverse a payment?
body: We paid the wrong supplier six weeks ago and have only just noticed. Is it too late to get it back?

subject: Which documents do you actually need?
body: We are adding a second company and the list on the site does not match what the email asked for.

subject: The self-service number on our report changed
body: The figure in this month's pack is different from last month and nothing else changed at our end. Why did it move?

subject: Payment shows twice on the statement
body: The same payment to the same supplier appears twice, one minute apart. Only one was made.

subject: How long does a reversal take to come back?
body: A reversal was approved on Thursday and the money is still not in the account.

subject: Why has the account been restricted?
body: We cannot make payments and payroll is Friday. Nobody will tell us what has happened or how long it lasts.
